gloss: wearing comfort; how comfortable clothes feel

definitions.explanation: The quality of comfort experienced when wearing clothes or other garments.

examples.japanese: このシャツは{着心地|きごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This shirt is comfortable to wear.

examples.japanese: {綿|めん}100%なので{着心地|きごこち}が{良|よ}い。
examples.english: It's 100% cotton, so it's comfortable to wear.

examples.japanese: {着心地|きごこち}{抜群|ばつぐん}のパジャマです。
examples.english: These are pajamas with exceptional comfort.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{着|き}る (to wear) + {心地|ここち} (feeling, sensation) → feeling while wearing

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{着心地|きごこち}がいい / {良|よ}い (comfortable to wear)
・{着心地|きごこち}が{悪|わる}い (uncomfortable to wear)
・{着心地|きごこち}{抜群|ばつぐん} (exceptionally comfortable)

RELATED ～{心地|ごこち} WORDS:
・{居心地|いごこち} (comfort of a place)
・{寝心地|ねごこち} (sleeping comfort)
・{乗|の}り{心地|ごこち} (ride comfort)
・{使|つか}い{心地|ごこち} (ease of use)

USAGE NOTE:
Commonly used for describing fabric texture, fit, and overall comfort of clothing. Frequently seen in clothing reviews and advertisements.
